products.name: Coast - Milk Chocolate Bar - 100mg
products.description: Coast Milk Chocolate Bar delivers 100mg of hybrid cannabis in a deliciously smooth, premium chocolate edible. This indulgent treat combines rich, creamy chocolate flavor with balanced hybrid effects that promote both relaxation and uplift. Perfect for those seeking a versatile experience, each bar offers precise dosing and convenient portability. The Coast brand is known for quality edibles that merge great taste with reliable potency. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or enhancing a social gathering, this milk chocolate bar provides a happy, euphoric experience with every bite. The 100mg total THC allows for customizable dosing—break off a piece for a milder effect or enjoy more for deeper relaxation. Ideal for chocolate lovers who appreciate the perfect balance of flavor and function in their cannabis edibles.

products.name: Coast - Goodnight Grape - Gummy - 5:25
products.description: Coast Goodnight Grape Gummies deliver a deliciously relaxing experience perfect for winding down after a long day. This Indica edible features 100mg total THC in a 5:25 THC:CBN ratio, offering balanced relaxation with added wellness benefits. Each grape-flavored gummy provides soothing effects ideal for evening use, helping you ease tension and prepare for restful sleep. Coast crafts these gummies with quality ingredients and consistent dosing, making them a reliable choice for those seeking deep relaxation and tranquility. The sweet grape flavor masks any cannabis taste, while the Indica classification ensures calming, full-body effects that melt away stress. Perfect for experienced users looking to unwind, relax, and enjoy a peaceful night's rest.

products.name: Coast - Dark Chocolate Sea Salt Bar - 100mg
products.description: Coast Dark Chocolate Sea Salt Bar delivers 100mg of premium hybrid cannabis in a sophisticated edible that balances indulgence with intention. This artisan chocolate bar combines rich, velvety dark chocolate with a delicate touch of sea salt, creating a luxurious flavor experience that elevates your cannabis consumption. Each precisely dosed square offers a balanced hybrid effect, perfect for those seeking relaxation without sedation or gentle euphoria paired with mental clarity. The smooth, creamy texture melts effortlessly on your palate while delivering consistent, predictable effects that both novice and experienced consumers can enjoy. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or seeking creative inspiration, this Coast chocolate bar transforms your edible experience into something truly special. The 100mg potency allows for flexible dosing—break off a small piece for a mild, uplifting effect or enjoy more for deeper relaxation and bliss.

Whether you're unwinding after a long day or treating yourself to something special, this 100mg bar offers a delightful way to elevate your experience. Break off a piece and savor the familiar flavors while discovering the benefits of a thoughtfully crafted cannabis edible. Perfect for chocolate lovers seeking a tasty, discreet, and enjoyable consumption method.

products.name: Coast - Strawberry Lemonade - Gummy - 10:5:5

Perfect for those seeking an uplifting, energetic effect, these gummies offer a balanced approach to cannabis consumption. The carefully crafted formula provides a happy, focused experience ideal for daytime use or social occasions. Coast blends quality ingredients with precision dosing to create edibles that taste as good as they perform. Whether you're looking for creative inspiration or simply want to elevate your mood, these Strawberry Lemonade Gummies from Coast offer a delicious, reliable way to enjoy sativa effects in a portable, discreet format.
